cards.card_text: Jesus and His disciples cross the sea by boat and land on the other side, in the region of the Gerasenes.
cards.verse_text: On the other side of the sea, they arrived in the region of the Gerasenes.
cards.snippet: …other side of the sea, they arrived in the region of the Gerasenes.

cards.card_text: Jesus and the disciples sail on to the region of the Gerasenes, across the lake from Galilee.
cards.verse_text: Then they sailed to the region of the Gerasenes, across the lake from Galilee.
cards.snippet: Then they sailed to the region of the Gerasenes, across the lake from Galilee.

cards.card_text: Great fear takes hold of all the people of the region of the Gerasenes.
cards.verse_text: Then all the people of the region of the Gerasenes asked Jesus to depart from them, because great fear had taken hold of them.
cards.snippet: Then all the people of the region of the Gerasenes asked Jesus to depart from them, because great fear had taken hold…
